issue.title: fix(ci): preserve main checks and repair release validation

repository.name: link-cli
repository.description: A CLI tool to manipulate links.

issue.body:
Fixes #207

## Changes

- Keep read-only checks for each default-branch revision and independent dispatch. Replace only superseded PR synchronization checks. Queue repository release writers so a later publish cannot displace a pending one.
- Remove the generated root `.gitkeep`. Preserve required status checks, language stage order, and golden fixture receipts.
- Verify the replacement etcd leader while the original member is paused. After it rejoins, verify convergence, refusal of the stale transaction, and a linearizable read through the resumed member. Set `ETCD_TEST_VERBOSE=1` or dispatch JS Client CI with **Record etcd election status and member debug logs** to capture election evidence.
- Fix Windows `mmap` and `file` ring teardown. A peer can still hold the mapping after JavaScript closes its descriptor. Both endpoints attempt removal after closing their regions, and JavaScript defers the sharing error to the peer. Bump the JS client to `0.5.1`.
- Retry Windows PID-lock sharing errors during cleanup in C#, Rust and JS. Bump the JS server to `0.1.2`. The C# recovery cases now share one real interrupted-store image and recover independent copies. Each fault and its deadline remain covered. Set `LINK_CSHARP_RECOVERY_TRACE=1` or the `CI_VERBOSE` repository variable for phase timings.
- Validate both npm tarballs and their size against the JS template’s budget on pull requests and checks-only dispatches. Main publishing requires a successful trusted-publisher preflight. A separate read-only job downloads the exact published version anonymously. Registry diagnostics distinguish package setup from a lookup outage.
- Cover shared stage inputs and integration examples in JS package triggers. Enforce a 30-minute workflow job timeout ceiling with documented caps for longer suites and release jobs. Resolve the Rust and C# source-size warnings and include release fragments.

## Reproduce and verify

- Draft #208 at `26852bd` fails `node --test js/test/repositoryLayout.test.mjs`. This test passes after removal of the placeholder.
- The original run reproduces the etcd failure. JS Client CI runs the real cluster in both journal modes. Run `node --test experiments/issue-138/etcd-harness.test.mjs` for the focused election checks. [Original failure](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46062568123)
- Windows IPC reproduced the mapped-file `EPERM`. Run `node --test --test-name-pattern='Windows ring cleanup' js/client/test/ipc-ring.test.mjs` to exercise shutdown, a handshake rejection and other I/O errors. The hosted IPC matrix also runs cross-language mmap and file conversations on Windows. [Original failure](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46075606690/job/140762688754) · [Passing Windows interop](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46080072248/job/140776911208)
- The hosted Windows C# log shows one leftover PID entry after eight successful imports and one deadline in version restart recovery. The PID cleanup tests cover transient and permanent errors. The Windows C# regression opens the owner file, observes a real rename rejection, closes the handle, and verifies the retry. The restart suite still exercises all twelve injected faults. [Original Windows failures](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46080072295/job/140778322490)
- Overlapping `main` revisions cancelled conformance and Rust tests. Run the CI governance and workflow policy tests in `.github/scripts` to exercise the policy. [Client cancellation](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46059980457) · [Rust cancellation](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46059980682)
- Hosted etcd passed the revised scenario in both journal modes. The anonymous package check downloaded `@link-foundation/link-cli-client@0.5.0` and reproduced npm HTTP 404 for `@link-foundation/link-cli-server@0.1.1`. [Hosted conformance](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46069793278/job/140744356887)
- Run `npm --prefix js run lint`, `npm --prefix js run test:js`, `node parity/check-parity.mjs --base origin/main`, and `npm pack --dry-run --json | node ../../.github/scripts/check-npm-tarball-size.mjs` from each npm package directory.
- Local verification passed 439 JavaScript stage tests, 41 focused JS store-lock tests with full module coverage, 61 targeted C# lock and restart cases, and the Rust store-lock checks. The hosted Windows job exercises the real directory rename and retry.
- This environment has no installed pre-commit hooks. The relevant checks were run manually, including workflow policy, JavaScript and Python quality, secrets, Rust formatting and lint, .NET formatting on the CI SDK, Actionlint and zizmor.

## External verification still needed

The server package’s public metadata and exact tarball return HTTP 404 at version `0.1.2`. The real OIDC exchange also returned HTTP 404 on `main`. An npm scope maintainer needs to publish the first public version or make an existing private package public, configure GitHub trusted publishing for `link-foundation/link-cli` and `js-server.yml`, and run JS server CI on `main` with **Verify npm trusted publishing** enabled before retrying the main workflow. The PR’s tarball and code checks run independently. The real publishing criterion remains open until the maintainer steps and main verification succeed. [Failed preflight](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46067149214)

GitHub reports a neutral PR CodeQL comparison for the C# autobuild category retired on October 24. The Security workflow scans all five current categories on both `main` and this PR. Clearing the neutral comparison requires repository-owner approval to remove the retired historical configuration from `main`. [CodeQL comparison](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/runs/140777680942) · [GitHub configuration cleanup](https://docs.github.com/en/code-security/how-tos/manage-security-alerts/manage-code-scanning-alerts/resolve-alerts#removing-stale-configurations-and-alerts-from-a-branch)

- [Investigation, timeline and requirements](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/blob/issue-207-ac4b1e2ba1ef/docs/case-studies/issue-207/README.md)
- [Run logs, template file comparison and local verification](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/blob/issue-207-ac4b1e2ba1ef/dev/log/issues/207/pulls/208/README.md)
- [Rust template #275](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/275), [JS template #325](https://github.com/link-foundation/js-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/325), [C# template #121](https://github.com/link-foundation/csharp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/121), [Python template #173](https://github.com/link-foundation/python-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/173), [Java template #39](https://github.com/link-foundation/java-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/39), [C++ template #45](https://github.com/link-foundation/cpp-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/issues/45), [Hive Mind #4186](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/issues/4186)

issue.title: Keep default-branch checks for each commit and preserve manual runs

repository.name: rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template
repository.description: A template for AI driven development pipeline for Rust

issue.body:
Pinned template evidence is in [`release.yml`, line 549](https://github.com/link-foundation/rust-ai-driven-development-pipeline-template/blob/1d29f5541bce3fd47925c0b498937aee19776121/.github/workflows/release.yml#L549). This concerns the current checks policy after #230.

The current workflow uses a branch-ref concurrency key and `cancel-in-progress: true` for read-only checks running on `main`. Two commits share the same key, so the later commit can cancel checks for the earlier commit. A release commit can cause this even when no other contributor is pushing. The release writer's own queue cannot recover a prerequisite that was cancelled.

The issue was observed in an adopter, link-foundation/link-cli#207. Its [JS conformance run](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46059980457) and [Rust pipeline](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46059980682) lost checks around overlapping default-branch updates. The template job linked above has the same concurrency policy.

### Reproduce in a disposable repository

Copy the cited workflow into a fork or test repository. Add `run: sleep 30` as the first step of its read-only check if it completes quickly. With publication disabled in the disposable repository, push two distinct qualifying commits to its default branch while the first check is running. Follow both runs with `gh run list --branch main --limit 5` and inspect the check results. On workflows with push path filters, update the workflow in both commits so both trigger it. Repeat with a manual run and a push or with two manual runs to check whether the branch key also conflates those events.

### Workaround and proposed change

Space pushes until the earlier run finishes as a temporary workaround. Use the key below in the template for each read-only job, retaining its matrix suffix where relevant. Keep writers on their existing shared repository queue.

```yaml
concurrency:
  group: check-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ (github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'synchronize' && github.ref) || (github.event_name == 'push' && github.sha) || github.run_id }}-check
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.action == 'synchronize' }}
```

A policy test can require per-SHA main checks, independent manual and ready runs, PR synchronization replacement, and retention of matrix and job suffixes. See the guide's [preserve a full check when a commit arrives](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/main/docs/CI-CD-BEST-PRACTICES.md#preserve-a-full-check-when-a-commit-arrives) and [GitHub's concurrency semantics](https://docs.github.com/en/actions/how-tos/write-workflows/choose-when-workflows-run/control-workflow-concurrency).

issue.title: Generated root .gitkeep can fail unconditional draft layout checks

repository.name: hive-mind
repository.description: The AI that controls AIs to do the automation of automation.

issue.body:
### Reproduction

Run `/fix --ci-cd` on a repository with a required root-layout check that disallows arbitrary root files, such as link-foundation/link-cli. The initial draft commit can contain only the generated root `.gitkeep`.

In the observed [draft](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/pull/208), [commit 26852bd](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/commit/26852bd276b6cdeef98316fae6d2526e2de80483) created the placeholder. The [required JavaScript stage](https://github.com/link-foundation/link-cli/actions/runs/46067171135) failed with `.gitkeep should live under the package-specific project tree or case-study evidence`. The shared stage gate then prevented Rust and C# checks from running. link-foundation/link-cli#207 collects the logs. Earlier placeholder cleanup work in #1528 and #2215 addresses expensive path-filtered jobs and preventing a placeholder from leaking into a final merge. Required checks can still fail as soon as the draft opens.

A local reproduction from a clean checkout of that repo is to add a root `.gitkeep`, stage it, and run `node --test js/test/repositoryLayout.test.mjs` (or run the JavaScript stage's `npm run test:js` command inside `js/`).

### Workaround and proposed change

Remove the generated file as part of the first real patch. Keep the repository's required checks and root allowlist in place.

Teach the draft creation path to try a payload-free Git commit where the host accepts an empty comparison, or allow a repository-configured placeholder path before falling back to a root file. If GitHub rejects a compare without a content diff, use the configured path instead. Keep the existing cleanup and placeholder-only detection for the fallback. Add a regression that prepares a solver draft against a repository with an unconditional layout guard and verifies that a supported placeholder strategy leaves the required check green.
